Shim run, recorded 2026-10-25 08:29 PDT on the merged tree (HEAD ae02e364465):

Shim: an executable sh script named git placed first on PATH. For 'git commit' it runs 'sleep 1.3' and then execs the real git; every other git subcommand passes straight through.
  case "$1" in commit) sleep 1.3;; esac; exec <real git> "$@"

Command: PATH=<shim dir>:$PATH pytest tests/unit/test_store_commit_maintenance_bd66.py -q -p no:cacheprovider
Result: '2 passed in 99.46s (0:01:39)'. Both tests passed: test_write_survives_foreground_maintenance_repack and test_the_trace_check_detects_maintenance_inside_a_commit.

For contrast, the pre-fix test, with its 1.0 s _GIT_TIMEOUT patch and the same 1.3 s delay, failed with 'git commit failed while holding lock: git timed out after 1.0s'. The new test patches no timeout, so a delayed commit cannot fail it.
